Name: Ultimate Coop and Barn
Author: bobkalonger
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Adds an immense new upgrade tier for the coop and barn, holding 48 animals. Auto-compatible with SVE and multiple other coop and barn mods, and you can choose between a clean or a cozy interior!
[/b][/size][/center]
This mod adapts to your modlist in a safe way. The mod will check for the compatible mods listed below, and change its config internally based on logic. Please note that adding or removing the compatible mods will [b]not[/b] break this mod. The behavior that is dynamic is Robin's upgrade menu, meaning the building to be upgraded and those upgrade costs are the only things to change. If my Ultimate buildings are already present on your farm, removing compatible mods will [b]not[/b] break those Ultimate buildings (again, only the upgrade cost and "building to upgrade" change in Robin's construction menu). Check the list below for compatible mods and the resulting behavior and see the table in the mod images for the building costs!

[i]*A small note on map design (see images): the player can walk behind the trough walls, but NPCs are completely blocked off from hiding back there. I have highlighted the region of the produce area, which won't allow any drops behind the walls either. Of course, the auto-petter and auto-grabber means the player isn't hunting around for NPCs to pet or drops to pick up, but I wanted to make sure these maps are as user friendly as possible. Oh yeah, you can put casks in here too![/i]


[center][size=5][b][color=#ff7700]----Compatible Mods----[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#1e84cc][size=4][b]!! THRILLED TO ANNOUNCE COMPATIBILITY WITH[/b][/size][/color][color=#1e84cc][size=4]
[b]VANILLA PLUS PROFESSIONS' OVERCROWDING TALENT !![/b][/size][/color][/center]
[color=#ffffff][size=3]I designed new maps to work with Overcrowding, and with that talent active, the Ultimate Coop and Barn can hold an unreasonable [b]SIXTY-FOUR (64)[/b] animals each! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url] is one of my favorite mods of all time and I have been working on this compatibility for weeks. I put in a lot of code to make sure your items are safe if you decide to toggle Overcrowding on/off in the talents menu. My mod will try to find space for map items on the map first, and if it can't, they will go to Lost and Found. The extra hay will attempt to redeposit into your Silo, and if that is full, Lost and Found.[/size][/color]

[i][color=#ffffff]When turning Overcrowding on, expect exactly 16 empty hay spots, they will fill overnight.[/color][/i]
[i][color=#ffffff]If the lights look out of place on the map after toggling the talent, just exit and re-enter![/color][/i]

[center][color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]N﻿ow with live config option to manually set your upgrade path! You can choose to upgrade Giga buildings or Mega buildings even with SVE installed!![/b][/size][/color][color=#6aa84f]
[i][size=2]**If you choose Mega, the mod will still scan for Resource Chickens and adapt[/size][/i][/color]

[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]If you want to upgrade SVE Premium buildings or the vanilla Deluxe buildings, please leave config on "Auto"!! The section below explains the behavior with "Auto" set:[/size][/color][/b][/center]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/size]
[size=3]With SVE installed, it will take precedence over all the other compats, and you must upgrade the Premium Coop and Premium Barn. Both doors work on the Ultimate Barn and I've added a second door to the Ultimate Coop (see images for location) for convenience (and for fun)![/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43940]Bigger on the Inside[/url][/size]
[size=3]You'll also need SVE to take advantage of this compatibility, and the upgrade chain will become Deluxe -> Premium -> Ultimate all while keeping the footprint and exterior appearance of the Deluxe buildings! This means your reskins will work the whole way.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33727]Gigantic Coop and Barn[/url][/size]
[size=3]Without SVE installed, this would be next for compatibility. You will have Deluxe building exteriors, and no extra doors. However, because these buildings are already so expensive and pretty close in capacity, I've adjusted the cost to 0 gold (also a thank you to fans of this, my other mod!!), so you only need to pay Robin materials.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25586]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/url][/size]
[size=3]This would be next down the list, and yes you can have both Mega and Resource Chickens at the same time!! Just make sure you go into the Mega config and shut off the Mega Coop so that the Giant Coop from Resource Chickens becomes available![/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21800]Resource Chickens[/url][/size]
[size=3]If you have only this mod installed out of my compatibility list, you'll upgrade the Deluxe Barn and Giant Coop.[/size]

[center][size=4][color=#6aa84f][b]Otherwise, this mod works even when none of the above are installed! Just upgrade your Deluxe Coop and Barn!![/b][/color][/size]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]All Ultimate buildings come with a heater, auto-grabber, and auto-petter.
Ultimate Coops will always have FOUR incubators, so get crackin'![/size][/color][/b][/center]

[center][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]----Mods Adding Coop/Barn Animals----[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=4]As far as I know, all of these mods should work with my mod! The barns are barns and the coops are coops. The snozberriers taste like snozberries. Let me know if you run into any issues![/size]


[center][color=#1e84cc][size=5][b]----Reskins/Recolors----[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=4]Ultimate Coop and Barn should be compatible with any farm animal reskin mods. If you're using SVE, my buildings will use any exterior reskin or recolor that works for the Premium buildings. If you're not using SVE, you'll have vanilla buildings and can use any vanilla reskins or recolors. Here are my favorite mods in this category!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27521]Coop and Barn Facelift Redux

[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37726]Jeelh's Farm Buildings[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704]Updated Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][/size]

[center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=5]----Visually Incompatible Mods----[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[size=2]I say “visually incompatible” to mean that there will be a discontinuity once you upgrade to my buildings. Some mods only affect vanilla maps, some have added maps for Jen’s Mega Coop and Barn or SVE Premium Buildings, and some even work with VPP maps...until you upgrade to my Ultimate (or Giga) buildings. I want to specifically state that those visual effects [i]will not carry over into my maps[/i], whether it’s grassy floors, indoor pools, or wall vines, it won’t be there for Ultimate (or Giga) buildings. I haven’t tested these in my own game, but they should load up and work fine in the context they were meant to work (refer to each mod’s page for details).[/size]

[left][size=4][color=#ff7700]﻿
[size=1][i]I learned so much while building this mod, and went through countless revisions of the maps to make them just right. If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, please leave a comment, I would very much appreciate it!

Personally, my favorite part of this mod is the code for the upgrade sign. It was quite difficult to figure out because I only code and mod on a hobby level and don't have much experience. Content Patcher can't actually use UpgradeSignTile and UpgradeSignHeight even though the documentation on the web AND inside of Stardew Valley itself claims that Content Patcher can. Believe me, I tried countless different tweaks to the Content Patcher portion of this mod, and nothing worked. No matter what I tried, the sign wouldn't show up on the Deluxe Barn during upgrades, and it showed up on the Deluxe Coop but I couldn't move it. Forget about it showing up on buildings from other mods! For some reason, I got really hung up on this minor functionality (most buildings in the game don't get upgraded, and your farmhouse never shows an upgrade sign). So it was incredibly satisfying to work out the SMAPI code to get the sign to behave how I want. Now I want to see what other buildings I can upgrade, just to use that code somewhere else! Of course I'm open to suggestions! :)[/i][/size][/color][/size][/left]

Downloads.Description:
Use this file along with Building Footprint Swapper to upgrade Deluxe/Mega/Giant/Giga buildings to the larger footprint version of the Ultimate buildings! SVE mandatory for exterior texture. Added BFS as a hard dependency in 1.0.3

Manifest Key: @UUP

Manifest.Name: Ultimate Upgrade
Manifest.Description: This mod will shift the Ultimate Coop and Barn to upgrade the Deluxe/Mega/Giga Coop and Barn (and Giant Coop), while retaining the larger footprint and exterior texture of the SVE Premium Coop or Barn, including the extra doors.
Manifest.Author: bobkalonger
